qualityReview.identity: Preserves regal ivory dragon, cyan glass membranes and insets, gold prism horns, four clawed legs, two wings and long tapering tail.
qualityReview.scene: Dragon drives across shattered alpine ridge; foreground mineral rock, midground planted claws, distant mountain peaks and waterfalls show depth and directional sunlight.
qualityReview.composition: Face and crown upper third; claws form strong forward action and both wing membranes remain recognizable.
qualityReview.constraints: Opaque illustration; no text, frame, UI, watermark or logo seen.
caveats: Outer wing membranes crop at left and right borders; head, horns and core anatomy remain clear.
